As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/s Megacities. Las Vegas
programme.desc: When you think about where to play, you immediately think of Las Vegas, this man-made oasis created by people in the middle of the desert. However, the main secret of Las Vegas is not the game itself, not the connections, or even the sex. The basis of this metropolis is electricity. Without electricity, Las Vegas will simply die. In this series you will see Las Vegas as no one has ever seen it before. Power lines are his arteries, and electricity is his blood. We will look behind the outer cover of this metropolis, get acquainted with its vital organs and descend lower than anyone else - into the very heart of the metropolis. In a city built in a rather risky place to live, energy is a window into the soul of the city, because making the pulse of this city beat is the biggest game of all. Cast: Jackie Chan. UK, USA, 2006

programme.title: d/s Megacities. London
programme.desc: George Orwell once warned humanity of a future in which “Big Brother is watching everyone.” Today in London there is such a big brother, but he is not some kind of all-seeing eye, on the contrary, it is an eye warning of danger. Not one, but three great rivers flow through London - by air, by water and by land. They play a key role in keeping London alive and running: London is the world's busiest international air travel hub; The Thames is the busiest urban river in the world; London's streets are so congested with traffic that you have to pay just to drive through them. One serious traffic accident in the city can stop all traffic in this metropolis, where the movement of people and goods is the key to its survival. Every minute, millions of people and cars are on a collision course. To avoid a serious accident, London uses a high-tech surveillance system, the sensors of which are located literally everywhere - in the air, on the river and on land. It's a city like no other: step behind the scenes to see the "watcher of the watchers" and the incredible complexity of technology operating in all three dimensions, from air traffic control towers to the murky and dangerous depths of the Thames. London is literally racing on a collision course to its future and cannot take its eyes off the prize waiting for it. Starring: Paterson Joseph, Claudia Sheinbaum, Jacobo Zabludovsky, Tk Singh, Juan Manuel Espinoza, Pedro Ferríz de Con, Arturo Aispuro, Jackie Chan. UK, USA, 2006

programme.title: Katavi: Africa's Lost Garden of Eden, 3 c
Wild wonders of Europe, 3 pp. Coast
A Wild Year on Earth: September-October – A Time of Activation (S1E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep5 «A Wild Year on Earth»…In southern Africa, the dry season is intensifying and stressed hippos crowd into smaller and smaller ponds, while in Australia the onset of spring sets young kangaroos on fire. In the rice fields of southwest China, the world's largest harvest is ready to be harvested. In the northern hemisphere, the September equinox marks the onset of fall. The caribou of northern Canada begin a migration to escape the approaching winter, avoiding hungry wolves. The tropical seas echo the songs of the humpback whale's mating season | Just as humans modify their behaviour to match their own calendar of rituals, animals coordinate their physiology and anticipate changes in the environment according to what their biological clocks dictate. Aiming to explain how various species handle the rhythmic natural patterns as they grow more extreme and turbulent every year, the story takes a closer look at the planet's most extraordinary seasonal events of migration, rebirth, and transformation | Director: Karina Holden

programme.title: A Wild Year on Earth: November-December – Full Circle (S1E6). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep6
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep6 «A Wild Year on Earth»…Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexico's forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter | Charts the planet's most spectacular events of migration, rebirth and transformation. Over the course of a turbulent year, we witness how finely tuned creatures face the Earth's seasonal patterns. However, in the 21st Century, these patterns are becoming more extreme, less predictable and dangerously unreliable. Across the globe, we witness the drama and the spectacle. No matter what time of year it is, somewhere on Earth something miraculous is happening | Director: Karina Holden

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue: Recovering Red-tailed Hawks (S1E11). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2014. S1, Ep11
programme.desc: 2014 г. Год: 2014. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2014. S1, Ep11 «City Wildlife Rescue»…Investigate the interesting cases of two red-tailed hawks who need help getting back into fighting shape. Then watch the medical team bring in a feisty, rare white squirrel who can't move his lower body. Will they be able to help him walk again? | This 12 part documentary series will show which animals actually live in the city, and what kind of trouble they encounter. When they do need help a rescue team is dispatched. Once rescued the animals are brought to this humble, but efficient, facility where a full time veterinarian is on hand. Problems are assessed, plans are put into action. Thousands of animals a year get a second chance at survival because of the dedicated volunteers and professionals who are united in their love of nature | Director: Sharone Ostrovski | Cast: Amanda Peter

programme.title: Evolution Earth: Islands (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2023. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep2 «Evolution Earth»…Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems | Evolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. programme.title: PAWN STARS S24 EP604

programme.title: DIỄN VIÊN ĐÓNG THẾ VÕ THUẬT - KUNGFU STUNTMEN
programme.desc: Điện ảnh hành động Hồng Kông nổi tiếng với những chiêu thức kung fu chân thực được thực hiện bởi một nhóm có tên “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. Bộ phim tài liệu này nhằm tri ân các thế hệ diễn viên đóng thế kung fu, với đoàn làm phim đã dành hơn hai năm để đào bới các kho lưu trữ và phỏng vấn nhiều tài năng, bao gồm cả những bậc thầy nổi bật nhất như Thành Long, Chân Tử Đan và Hồng Kim Bảo.

programme.title: HỎA VÂN TÀ THẦN: MẶT NẠ TU LA - THE MASK OF SHURA OF FIRE CLOUD
programme.desc: 18 năm trước, tộc Black Feather độc ác đã xâm nhập vào lãnh thổ của Master Fire Cloud và đánh cắp Mặt nạ Shura, từ đó giải phóng một linh hồn tà ác là một đứa bé. Master Fire Cloud đã nhận nuôi đứa bé để ngăn cậu trở thành ác quỷ. Khi đứa bé lớn lên, nó nắm quyền điều khiển chiếc mặt nạ và trở thành người kế nhiệm Fire Cloud với tư cách là người bảo vệ thành phố.

programme.title: TAY ĐẤM HUYỀN THOẠI - FIST OF LEGEND
programme.desc: Khi Chen Zhen học ở Nhật Bản, anh phát hiện một số sinh viên Trung Quốc mất tích và vô tình phát hiện ra âm mưu của Hội Rồng Đen. Một loại thuốc mới được phát minh để tăng cường sức khỏe cho quân đội Nhật Bản trong chiến tranh và các sinh viên Trung Quốc được sử dụng trong thí nghiệm của họ. Chen Zhen thề sẽ tiêu diệt tổ chức tà ác và phá hủy phòng thí nghiệm bí mật của chúng.
